Read input: origen_059597.v · Open raw
module origen_059597
#(
    parameter DBIT = 8,
    parameter SB_TICK = 16
)
(
    input wire clk, reset,
    input wire tx_start, clock_enable,
    input wire [7:0] din,
    output reg tx_done, tx_ack,
    output wire tx
);

    // State definition
    localparam [1:0]
        IDLE  = 2'b00,
        START = 2'b01,
        DATA  = 2'b10,
        STOP  = 2'b11;

    // Signal declaration
    reg [1:0] state_reg, state_next;
    reg [3:0] s_reg, s_next;
    reg [2:0] n_reg, n_next;
    reg [7:0] b_reg, b_next;
    reg tx_reg, tx_next;

    // State and data registers
    always @(posedge clk, posedge reset)
    begin
        if (reset)
        begin
            state_reg <= IDLE;
            s_reg <= 0;
            n_reg <= 0;
            b_reg <= 0;
            tx_reg <= 1'b1;
        end
        else if (clock_enable)
        begin
            state_reg <= state_next;
            s_reg <= s_next;
            n_reg <= n_next;
            b_reg <= b_next;
            tx_reg <= tx_next;
        end
    end

    // Next-state logic and output logic
    always @*
    begin
        state_next = state_reg;
        s_next = s_reg;
        n_next = n_reg;
        b_next = b_reg;
        tx_next = tx_reg;
        tx_done = 1'b0;
        tx_ack = 1'b0;

        case (state_reg)
            IDLE:
            begin
                tx_next = 1'b1;
                if (tx_start)
                begin
                    state_next = START;
                    s_next = 0;
                    b_next = din;
                    tx_ack = 1'b1;
                end
            end

            START:
            begin
                tx_next = 1'b0;
                if (s_reg == 15)
                begin
                    state_next = DATA;
                    s_next = 0;
                    n_next = 0;
                end
                else
                    s_next = s_reg + 1;
            end

            DATA:
            begin
                tx_next = b_reg[0];
                if (s_reg == 15)
                begin
                    s_next = 0;
                    b_next = b_reg >> 1;
                    if (n_reg == (DBIT-1))
                        state_next = STOP;
                    else
                        n_next = n_reg + 1;
                end
                else
                    s_next = s_reg + 1;
            end

            STOP:
            begin
                tx_next = 1'b1;
                if (s_reg == (SB_TICK-1))
                begin
                    state_next = IDLE;
                    tx_done = 1'b1;
                end
                else
                    s_next = s_reg + 1;
            end
        endcase
    end

    // Output
    assign tx = tx_reg;

endmodule
